You can use all leading AI models on Perplexity Orchestrator API

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-25T21:19:42+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2125700981208072235; média: videó, 97 másodperc]
Legend says Archimedes burned Roman ships at Syracuse in 212 BC with sunlight from mirrors.

The idea is to aim many flat mirrors at the same spot, as 70 Greek sailors did to a tarred boat in 1973, and as MIT students did with 127 mirrors in 2005.

I used the new Perplexity Orchestrator API to simulate this with 47 mirrors, each controlled independently by one of 47 different AI models.

Each API request has the same prompt but a different model ID, and each response is two angles in JSON. All 47 beams hit a pitch-coated pine panel, which ignited at 475°C after 53 requests and $0.62 in API spend.
